description.value:
Frequency once per combat

Your first attack each combat automatically treats the target as off-guard.

The first Strike you make in a combat treats its target as off-guard, whether or not it otherwise would be, and whether or not the target has already acted. This is not a Feint and requires no check. If that Strike hits, it also deals The Opening's precision damage even if the target would not otherwise qualify.

cinderfall.incomplete: "The Opening" precision-damage baseline is unencoded anywhere in this class's cards -- checked classes.scavenger-spy.json ("rules": []) and all four Angle cards (cutpurse/enforcer/face/fixer, each "rules": []). Real pf2e's equivalent (Sneak Attack) needs flags.system.sneakAttackDamage + a tagged DamageDice keyed to target:condition:off-guard + ItemAlteration weapon-tagging (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/sneak-attack.json:27-86) -- none of that scaffolding exists anywhere in the scavenger-spy corpus. Authoring it from scratch would mean editing the class or Angle cards, outside this pass's named-file scope. Extends a precision-damage baseline that doesn't exist anywhere in this corpus.
